scene: Inside the tea hut, three travel booths await your next destination.
picture: A flat side view inside the warm hilltop tea hut along one floor line. Far left, a wicker gate opens toward a tethered hot-air balloon basket. The boy in his orange vest and scarf stands left of centre. Centre, a frosty turnstile waits beside a red sleigh tram. Far right, a gangway meets a glass-bottomed boat.
shown: a wicker gate leading to a hot-air balloon basket, far left
a frosty turnstile beside an idling red sleigh tram, centre
a wooden gangway reaching down to a glass-bottomed boat, far right
